import rle.core as rle
# Test cases
assert rle.encode('aaabbc') == 'a3b2c1'
assert rle.encode('a') == 'a1'
assert rle.encode('') == ''
assert rle.encode('abc') == 'a1b1c1'
assert rle.encode('x'*12) == 'x12'
# Round-trip property for a variety of strings
import random
import string
for _ in range(1000):
    length = random.randint(0, 10)
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters) for __ in range(length))
    assert rle.decode(rle.encode(s)) == s
# TypeError
try:
    rle.encode(123)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    AssertionError('encode did not raise TypeError for non-string')
print('All tests passed')
